diagram_previews.alt: Equilateral triangle ABC with B at bottom left, C at bottom right and an interior point P joined to A, B and C. The point P' outside the triangle beyond side AB is the image of P under the 60 degree rotation about B; blue dashed segments BP', PP' and AP' are drawn, with a right-angle mark at P' between P'A and P'P.
